description.value: Kelly O'Bryan's is an Irish-themed family restaurant and pub chain with locations across British Columbia, established in 1988. The Kamloops outpost on Victoria Street offers casual sit-down dining with a full menu, a kids menu, and an extensive wine and liquor selection. The chain is well known for its 'Birthday Tradition,' a free birthday meal program that has cumulatively donated nearly $900,000 to local food banks across BC.
